title: Japanese Citrusy Goat Cheese Tart
description: A refreshing Japanese twist on a classic tart, featuring citrusy goat cheese and a crunchy crust.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together flour, confectioners' sugar, and salt.
Add in cold unsalted butter and mix until the dough resembles coarse crumbs.
Gradually add in eggs and mix until a dough forms.
Wrap dough in plastic wrap and refrigerate for 30 minutes.
Roll out dough to a thickness of 1/8 inch.
Transfer dough to a 9-inch tart pan with a removable bottom.
In a separate bowl, mix together goat cheese, lemon zest, and orange marmalade.
Pour cheese mixture into the tart shell.
Bake for 35-40 minutes, or until crust is golden brown.
